dialogues.speaker: Marvin
dialogues.text: I... I have a friend. Yes, a friend...

dialogues.speaker: Marvin
dialogues.text: He's very taken with a certain girl, but unfortunately, she doesn't come from a particularly wealthy family, so my friend's rather worried that his father will oppose their marriage.

dialogues.speaker: Marvin
dialogues.text: Thing is, he truly loves that girl and wants her to be his wife.

dialogues.speaker: Marvin
dialogues.text: So I... well, he, is wondering if he should simply come clean with his father...

choices.text: You sure you're talking about a friend?

response.speaker: Marvin
response.text: Ahem! *cough* D—Don't you say such scurrilous things...

response.speaker: Marvin
response.text: Wait a moment, you haven't been sent by the old man to test me, have you?

response.speaker: Marvin
response.text: Hmph, whatever. I said nothing. Just go.

response.speaker: Marvin
response.text: *cough* Ah, uh. I said nothing. You didn't hear anything from me!
